Commentary.Commentary: The target is a small one and Australia will back themselves to chase it down! England need to take wickets and a lot of them. Can they do it?

England just could not get their innings going! They kept losing wickets and had it not been for Alexa Stonehouse, it would have been embaressing for them. She batted really well ad got good support from Josie Groves to take them close to the 100-run mark but they are still well below par.

An excellent bowling performance from the Aussies and they are favorites to enter the final from here! Right from the word go they managed to take wickets. Three of their bowlers managed to take three but it was Ella Hayward who did the damage by taking three big wickets. It though was a combined effort from the bowlers.
OUT! TAKEN! That is the end of the innings! England end with 99! On off, this is lofted down towards long off and an easy catch is taken.

It is time for the second semi finals and it is a clash between England and Australia. The former have been really good in the tournament so far, they are still to lose a game. They come up against an Aussie side who suffered a shock defeat against Bangladesh in their first game but since then, have played really good cricket. Who will face India in the finals?
